tasks.title: Bound queue admission and shutdown
tasks.task:
Implement the deterministic scheduler state machine (not real OS workers). limit is a positive integer. submit admits unique active/pending IDs FIFO up to limit and queues the rest. finish removes an active ID and fills available capacity FIFO; finishing an unknown or pending ID is a no-op. shutdown closes admission, drops pending work, and retains active work until finished. Ignore new submissions after shutdown. Return an independent state snapshot after every event; arrays must be [] rather than null. Completed IDs may be submitted again.
